comment: M5-003 row shape (one hit presentation per attack reaction), filled by M5-017 with real resources. react montages: RCT_Hit (the mannequin heavy hit react MM_HitReact_Front_Hvy_01) presents the victim's HitStun entry for every non-launching hit; the launcher's reaction montage stays an honest placeholder (no mannequin launch clip exists in the engine template or the free Quaternius tier) while its confirmed-hit sound is real. The sounds are the M1-034 Kenney Impact CC0 hit sound (damage face only - a pure-control hit presents its montage but never fakes the damage audio; down/recover/dead presentations carry no confirmed damage event and no audio). The presentation-layer reaction kinds (hit/launch/down/recover/dead) live in UCombatPresentationComponent::MakeDefaultReactionPresentationTable; the down/recover rows of that table stay placeholder for the same missing-clip reason. Refused hits (immunity, faction filter, get-up protection) enter no state and never present anything.
